cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Warmly Withholding
cards.instruction: Remain open, caring, and reassuring while revealing less with every new question.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Your school meeting went fine, love. The headteacher and I discussed your suspension. Have some tea.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. A little while. I'll be home with you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Will I miss the school play?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Oh, sweetheart. Come sit beside me. You don't have to face this alone.

mechanism: A warmly grants access to companionship while shrinking the information allowed about the child's suspension.
confusable: Unlike simply refusing questions, A remains affectionate and offers more care as factual answers diminish.
comparison: A child's missed play and parent company differ from a missing dress and customer-service contact.
seedUse: Use suspension, duration and play sequence; make S01 gentle permission over what can be discussed instead of the original cold deferral.
